members.name: Olivia Chevalier
members.bio: Olivia founded FYM as a freshman in high school, bringing together marketing, creativity, and entrepreneurship with a simple goal: give students a place to make work they can stand behind.
members.detail: FYM began with marketing work for small businesses. That early version of the organization shaped the way FYM still works today: take responsibility, make decisions, and build something with care.
